The team was coached by [[Stan Heath]] in his third year at the school. USF played its home games in the [[USF Sun Dome]] and is a member of the [[Big East Conference (1979–2013)|Big East Conference]]. The Bulls finished the season 20–13, 9–9 in Big East play. They lost in the second round of the [[2010 Big East men's basketball tournament]] to [[2009–10 Georgetown Hoyas men's basketball team|Georgetown]] and were invited to play in the [[2010 National Invitation Tournament]] where they lost in the first round to [[2009–10 NC State Wolfpack men's basketball team|North Carolina State]]. In the Week 13 poll released on February 8, USF received two AP Poll votes (unofficially ranking them 44th), marking the first time in school history that the USF men’s basketball team has received votes in any rankings polls.{{Cite web |date=2010-02-08 |title=Bulls Receive Votes in Men's Basketball AP Poll |url=https://gousfbulls.com/news/2010/2/8/204883650 |access-date=2024-02-26 |website=USF Athletics |language=en}} ==Roster== {| class="wikitable" style="text-align: center;" |- !
